terra.problem: Saying the wanting is the whole point overlooks Peter’s stated purpose: growing up in salvation.
Peter says they grow by the spiritual milk, not that the craving itself is how growth happens.
The explanation puts invented words in God’s mouth. Its reference to Papa’s backstory also needs to identify the drawer.
“Nothing about this stone is tucked away” asserts more than the passage says. Peter does not describe it as hidden.
It tells the individual baker they are part of the spiritual house without knowing whether they are a believer.
“You’re on the team” assumes the individual baker belongs to the priesthood Peter describes.
The passage does not say that robes or sheet music are not required.
Identifying Moses as Israel’s leader is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Aaron’s identification as a priest needs a reference. Exodus 4:14 supports his relationship to Moses, not his priesthood.
The mustache working overtime has no clear connection to growing old, so the joke fails the logic test.
The explanation is flat and mechanical, repeating the answer without much of Papa Dorin’s voice.
“You belong to Him” assumes the individual baker is among the believers Peter addresses.
The reference to Papa’s own dark-to-light experience needs to identify the drawer so the baker has the backstory.
The passage does not say that nobody becomes part of God’s people by accident.
The claim that mercy is not earned goes beyond this passage and needs a supporting reference.
The explanation is generic and repetitive: its last two sentences simply restate that mercy is the answer.
